zh-CN.title: 更顺畅的 PWA 账户登录
items: 已选空间可直接用昵称和可选访问密码登录其他账户，无需重复输入空间名
主动登录其他账户时保留账户列表并展开登录表单，不再自动进入已有账户

en.title: Smoother PWA account sign-in
items: Sign in to another account in the selected space with a nickname and optional password
Explicitly adding an account keeps the account list visible and opens sign-in instead of automatically entering an existing account
